verdict.rationale: The only AI-related evidence describes a 'Payroll AI' that collects time data, flags inconsistencies, and texts the admin updates. That is a proactive, outbound agent feature, not an interface where the user operates the product by issuing natural-language commands, so it is an adjacent feature that earns no credit. The rest of the pack covers payroll features and developer APIs (GraphQL, webhooks, llms.txt), which are building blocks rather than natural-language operation, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.
